entries.translation_en: Splendid! Simply marvelous!!
In honor of that beautiful

entries.text_jp: 友惰に免じて…この醵い女共を
entries.translation_en: friendship of yours... the whereabouts of the key

entries.text_jp: しばるクサリの鍵のありか…
entries.translation_en: to the chains binding those ugly girls...

entries.text_jp: 教えてさし部げますわ!
entries.translation_en: I shall graciously tell you!

entries.text_jp: クサリの鍵は最部階に…
entries.translation_en: The key to the chains is on the top floor...

entries.text_jp: 持っているんですのよ!!
entries.translation_en: held in my very own hands!!

entries.text_jp: この醵い女共を肪けたかったら
entries.translation_en: If you wish to save those hideous wretches,

entries.text_jp: ワタクシの斯までくる事ですわね!オホホホッ!
entries.translation_en: you'll just have to climb all the way up to me! Ohohoho!

entries.text_jp: そぉ…左にまっすぐ行けば
entries.translation_en: Yes... just head straight to the left
and you'll be there in no time...
However,

entries.text_jp: あなたたちがノドから手が申る
entries.translation_en: that 'Mirror Shard'
which you desire so desperately
you can practically taste it...

entries.text_jp: ワタクシの立っている
entries.translation_en: is located 'beyond the door
right behind where I stand'...
Yes, indeed...
Inside a grand treasure chest,
along with 'the hint to defeating me'!

entries.text_jp: 一緒にしまってありますわ
entries.translation_en: It's locked away for safekeeping.
There is no time limit

entries.text_jp: 時間刷限がありませんからねェ
entries.translation_en: in this tower, after all~

entries.text_jp: ゆっくり取りに行けましてよ!
entries.translation_en: You can take your sweet time retrieving it!

entries.text_jp: お友運にはちょっとの間
entries.translation_en: Your little friends will just have to endure
What you choose to do

entries.text_jp: あなたたちの自由ですわ!
entries.translation_en: is entirely up to your own free will!
Farewell, and good day!

entries.text_jp: トロ:たすけてください!
entries.translation_en: Toro: P-Please save me!
Where is
the key to
my heart?!
Demon Teacher: Come on, come on!

entries.text_jp: もっとしっかりやるザマす!
entries.translation_en: Put your back into it, zamasu!
Drink it all down, zamasuuu!
Keep working, zamasuuu!
The 'Mirror Shard' is important too...
What should we do?
Unforgivable...
Isn't this good medicine for them?

entries.text_jp: アヤセあの二人苦手だしィ…
entries.translation_en: Ayase can't stand those two anyway...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺は｜鍖の破片』よりも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Rather than the 'Mirror Shard',

entries.text_jp: この2人を肪けるよりも
entries.translation_en: or even saving those two,
I want to go beat Michiko's face in

entries.text_jp: ブチのめしに行きたい…!!
entries.translation_en: this very second...!!

entries.text_jp: 悪い奴等じゃないんだ
entries.translation_en: They aren't bad kids.

entries.text_jp: 帛く肪けてやりたいゼ!
entries.translation_en: I wanna save 'em as fast as possible!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:本当にいやなヤツ!
entries.translation_en: Elly: What a truly repulsive person!

entries.text_jp: 命令されてやってるだけザマす
entries.translation_en: I'm only doing what I was ordered to do, zamasu.
If you've got complaints,

entries.text_jp: 美智子達に言うザマす
entries.translation_en: take them up with Lady Michiko, zamasu!
No good...
This treasure chest?
Are you making a complete fool
out of us?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの美智子のことだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Knowing that Michiko,
a trick this completely pointless...

entries.text_jp: イヤミなコト位するだろう
entries.translation_en: is right up her alley.
This letter...

entries.text_jp: この部厘までの道のり…
entries.translation_en: Completely unforgivable!
Falling for a trap like this...
Elly: Is this what Michiko meant by
'the hint'?

entries.text_jp: それにしても…擇聞部厘から
entries.translation_en: How cruel...!
She intended to deceive us from the very beginning.
Unforgivable!
We have to hurry!
Hang on, you two!
We'll save you!

entries.text_jp: これでこの箱に｜鍖の破片』が
entries.translation_en: She plays so dirty!
Just you wait, Michiko!
I'll never forgive you!
It was a trap!
Baiting us with a treasure chest...
I'm gonna deck her!
There's nothing inside...
It's completely empty!
There's a slip of paper inside...
A letter?
Something's written on it.
Let's read it.
What does it say?
'To the greedy fools who came all this way...'

entries.text_jp: ちょっと時間をかけすぎたね
entries.translation_en: She's mocking us!
'Did you really think it would be that easy to obtain?'
Nanjo: Even I
am losing my temper now.
Such an arrogant woman.
Just like Michiko's rotten personality,
it's completely twisted.
We fell right into her trap.
Let's get back quickly!

entries.text_jp: まで帰るのかと思うとゾッと
entries.translation_en: Let's go save Toro and the others!
We'll make her pay dearly for this!

entries.text_jp: ちょっと一休みしません?
entries.translation_en: Making a fool out of us!

entries.text_jp: さすがに疸れましたわ
entries.translation_en: Let's head to the top floor!
We'll settle this once and for all!
Inside the chest, there is something like a letter.
...It appears to be a letter from Michiko.
Opened the letter.

entries.text_jp: この宝箱までたどり善くとは
entries.translation_en: 'To think you would actually reach this chest...'

entries.text_jp: ほんとに独歓な人運ですコト!
entries.translation_en: 'What wonderfully eccentric fools you are!'

entries.text_jp: さぞ大変だったでしょうねェ
entries.translation_en: 'It must have been terribly exhausting, no?'

entries.text_jp: どぉ?お目当てのモノは
entries.translation_en: 'Well? Was the prize you were seeking

entries.text_jp: あったでございましょ?
entries.translation_en: waiting for you, I wonder?'
'Did you truly believe
the Mirror Shard was inside?'
'Ohohohoho!'
'How delightfully foolish of you!'

entries.text_jp: あんまり時間をかけないコト
entries.translation_en: 'To abandon your precious classmates'
'and rush straight for the treasure...'

entries.text_jp: オ{204}ッホホホホホホ!念いで
entries.translation_en: 'Humans truly are despicable creatures!'

entries.text_jp: ワタクシの斯までいらしてね!
entries.translation_en: 'You chose power over your own friends!'

entries.text_jp: お待ちしてるわヨン鷺
entries.translation_en: 'And because you came here,'

entries.text_jp: どぉ?参考になりまして?
entries.translation_en: 'my power has grown even stronger!'
'Farewell, and good day!'
The treasure chest is already empty.

entries.text_jp: お筆み僵り!禾てやったよ!!
entries.translation_en: Just as you wished! We've come for you!!
Hand over the 'Key to the Chains'
binding Toro and Kurosu!

entries.text_jp: 何なら力ずくでもイイんだよ!
entries.translation_en: We'll take it by force if we have to!
Michiko: Ohohoho!
You actually made it to the top floor!
I am truly impressed.

entries.text_jp: 宸すつもりはないんだろ?
entries.translation_en: However...

entries.text_jp: こんなに帛くココに禾たの?
entries.translation_en: You came all this way
just to save those two pathetic losers?!

entries.text_jp: まさか取りに行かなかったの?
entries.translation_en: Why would you bother?
What could you possibly gain
from saving such worthless nobodies?!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシの力の源たる
entries.translation_en: It makes no sense whatsoever!

entries.text_jp: 人間の感惰の持つ｜莫』の力!
entries.translation_en: Humans only act
out of pure self-interest!
That is the absolute truth of this world!
I knew it...
Deep down, you only care about yourselves!

entries.text_jp: このワタクシの宇に入ってくる
entries.translation_en: That ugly instinct
resides within every single human:

entries.text_jp: まさか奴等あの擇聞を
entries.translation_en: the universal law that

entries.text_jp: 受けながらこんな感惰を
entries.translation_en: 'as long as I am fine, who cares about the rest?'
It is not something as noble
as 'emotion'!
It was a foolproof strategy
exploiting base human instinct!!

entries.text_jp: コトはないハズですわ!
entries.translation_en: Trying to save others
without expecting any reward in return...
That's nothing but a boldfaced lie!
That every single human possesses

entries.text_jp: ｜自分さえよければ他の者は
entries.translation_en: the ugly belief of 'as long as I am fine,
who cares about others?'

entries.text_jp: ほど高等な物ではありませんわ!
entries.translation_en: It is not something as noble as 'emotion'!
It was a strategy
exploiting base human instinct!!
Trying to save others

entries.text_jp: 他人を肪けようとするコトが
entries.translation_en: without expecting any reward...
That's nothing but a boldfaced lie!
A pathetic, hypocritical sham!!
You disgust me to my very core!
Yukino: Shut your trap already!

entries.text_jp: どうすればいいんですの?
entries.translation_en: You don't know a damn thing about us!
We don't need a reason or a reward

entries.text_jp: あんな奴等はほおっておいて
entries.translation_en: to help our friends!
Ayase: Yeah, totally!

entries.text_jp: 行っているところだがな
entries.translation_en: You're just projecting your own ugliness

entries.text_jp: フン!手達がない知扇をしぼり
entries.translation_en: onto everyone else, Michiko!

entries.text_jp: 何をどう企んでいたかは
entries.translation_en: You're just jealous 'cause you don't have

entries.text_jp: 手達は一つだけミスを犯した
entries.translation_en: a single real friend in the world!
Isn't that right?
Brown: Bam! Nailed it!
You're just a lonely, bitter snob!
Mark: You think you're so high and mighty,

entries.text_jp: コケにしておきながら
entries.translation_en: but you're the ugliest one here!
Nanjo: A true leader understands

entries.text_jp: 考えていたのではあるまいな?
entries.translation_en: the value of camaraderie and loyalty.

entries.text_jp: 愛瑶激物唾ばわりした罪!
entries.translation_en: You possess neither, Michiko.
Your vanity has blinded your soul.
Elly: Friendship is built on trust,
not calculated transactions.

entries.text_jp: おれ達の輝かしい経啀に搗が
entries.translation_en: Your twisted worldview is truly pitiful.
Michiko: What did you say...?!

entries.text_jp: テメ{204}みたいなヤツだけは
entries.translation_en: You dare mock me?!
How dare you speak to me that way!!

entries.text_jp: トロと悪魔鹿を痛めつけたコト!みんなを尤コロ
entries.translation_en: Tormenting Toro and Demon-kun! Treating everyone like little kittens!
You think you can just do whatever you want?!
You're the worst kind of bully!

entries.text_jp: このおれ達の事をペット
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Silence!! Silence, you vermin!!

entries.text_jp: 唾ばわりしたコトのお礼を!
entries.translation_en: I will hear no more of your insolence!!
Those two got exactly what they deserved!
They were eyesores, nothing more!

entries.text_jp: べっつに｜鍖の破片』は12杖
entries.translation_en: And you...

entries.text_jp: なくたって8杖くらいあれば
entries.translation_en: You dare lecture ME?!
I'll tear you limb from limb!!

entries.text_jp: アヤセぇトロと黒瓜は
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Toro and Kurosu
are a million times better than you!

entries.text_jp: かまわないんだけどォ
entries.translation_en: At least they're genuine!

entries.text_jp: アンタみたいなヤ{204}な女がァ
entries.translation_en: You're just fake and nasty!
Get a clue already!
You get what I'm saying?
Michiko: SHUT UP!!
SHUT UP, SHUT UP!!

entries.text_jp: うるさいですわッ!お黙り!!
entries.translation_en: Shut your filthy mouths!! Silence!!
What are you implying? Are you trying to say

entries.text_jp: ワタクシがあの醵い二人よりも
entries.translation_en: that I am inferior to those two hideous creatures?!
Me?! Inferior to THEM?!

entries.text_jp: この美しいワタクシが??
entries.translation_en: I, the gorgeous and flawless Michiko?!
How dare you! How DARE you!!
I have wealth! I have beauty! I have status!!
I have everything anyone could ever desire!!

entries.text_jp: 尤コロ鳳惰にワタクシの
entries.translation_en: Those two are nothing but pathetic trash!

entries.text_jp: たてた素嘖らしい作貰は
entries.translation_en: They are beneath my feet!!

entries.text_jp: ハイブラウすぎましたのね!
entries.translation_en: And you dare compare me to them?!
Unforgivable! Utterly unforgivable!!

entries.text_jp: やはりこの塔に入った時息で
entries.translation_en: I will crush you into dust!!

entries.text_jp: 皆殺しにしておくべきでしたわ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Your shrieking is unbearable.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:｜おうおう』うるさいぞ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: 'Oh, oh,' how noisy.

entries.text_jp: オットセイでもあるまいに…
entries.translation_en: A truly noble person does not need to scream

entries.text_jp: しかし綾臘の言うとおりだ
entries.translation_en: about their own supposed superiority.

entries.text_jp: ここで｜鍖の破片』を1杖や2杖取り逃したくらいで
entries.translation_en: Your insecurity is laid bare for all to see.

entries.text_jp: 俺運の勝刮は激きはせぬ!
entries.translation_en: You are pathetic.

entries.text_jp: 手達のような夘道どうあっても
entries.translation_en: Michiko: What did you call me...?!
Pathetic?! ME?!

entries.text_jp: まずは手達を倒すのみ!
entries.translation_en: You arrogant brat!!
You know nothing of my suffering!!

entries.text_jp: 往生鵙が悪いですわよ
entries.translation_en: Nothing of my pain!!
In middle school, everyone adored me!
I was the center of the world!!
Everyone praised my beauty and elegance!
And yet... when I entered high school...

entries.text_jp: 鍖で見てみるといいですわ
entries.translation_en: Those jealous wretches...
They turned their backs on me!!
They whispered behind my back!!
They cast me aside like garbage!!
Yukino: That's because you treated everyone like dirt!
You reap what you sow, Michiko!

entries.text_jp: 1杖や2杖取り逃したところで
entries.translation_en: Respect is earned, not demanded!

entries.text_jp: 私運は痛くもかゆくもないですわ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Lies! All lies!!
They were simply consumed by petty jealousy!!
None of them ever cared about me!
They were all phonies!

entries.text_jp: まっすぐここに禾た理由…
entries.translation_en: Every last one of them!!

entries.text_jp: あなたにいくら話しても
entries.translation_en: The only one who acknowledged my greatness...
The only one who gave me true power...
was the Snow Queen!!

entries.text_jp: さァ!覚悟してもらいますわよ!
entries.translation_en: Her mask granted me this magnificent realm!!

entries.text_jp: 私は絶対に認めませんわよ!
entries.translation_en: Here, I am absolute!!
Here, I am the ultimate ruler!!
There is no such thing as
'friendship'!
'Trust' is a meaningless delusion!
Such hollow concepts!!

entries.text_jp: ありはしないと言うことを!
entries.translation_en: I shall prove that they do not exist anywhere in this world!

entries.text_jp: アンタ運の敗牝をもって
entries.translation_en: Through your total and absolute defeat,

entries.text_jp: 証畍してさし部げますわ!!
entries.translation_en: I shall demonstrate it to you right now!!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシを守る鎌となり!
entries.translation_en: Become the shield that protects me!

entries.text_jp: アイツらを滅ぼす剣となれ!
entries.translation_en: Become the sword that annihilates them!
Awaken, Megami Nemesis!!

entries.text_jp: ペルソナを唾ぶつもりかい?
entries.translation_en: Tear these insolent fools to shreds!!
Grant them the agony of eternal despair!!

entries.text_jp: トロと黒瓜のお礼参りだァッ!
entries.translation_en: This is payback for Toro and Kurosu!!

entries.text_jp: 美智子のお部厘らしいね
entries.translation_en: Looks like this is Michiko's personal room.
Everything is dripping with gaudy luxury.
Fit for a self-proclaimed queen.
Time to end this nightmare!

entries.text_jp: この呈にならんだ顔は??
entries.translation_en: Persona, lend us your strength!!

entries.text_jp: 言うことを聞かなかった
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Behold my divine power!

entries.text_jp: 人間どものなれの果て…
entries.translation_en: Drown in the depths of your own folly!!
Nemesis, strike them down!!
Feel the wrath of a true queen!!
Your Personas are nothing before my might!!
Kneel before me and beg for mercy!!

entries.text_jp: 素嘖らしい巳なんでしょう!
entries.translation_en: Elly: Her demonic resonance is intense!

entries.text_jp: どうかしら?ワタクシの
entries.translation_en: Be on your guard, everyone!

entries.text_jp: お気に召していただけ
entries.translation_en: Do not let her illusions deceive you!
Strike at the core of her shadows!

entries.text_jp: 苦しむ友人運を見捨てて
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Aizen Myo-ou, guide my blade!

entries.text_jp: 物歓にかられたうすぎたない
entries.translation_en: Righteous discipline shall prevail over vanity!
Yukino: Vesta, burn away her wicked arrogance!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシからの膃り物
entries.translation_en: You're going down, Michiko!!
Brown: Hehehe, nobody messes with Brown Todoroki!

entries.text_jp: 受け取ってもらえたようね
entries.translation_en: Taste my righteous fury!!

entries.text_jp: こうまで箸単にワタクシの
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Like, totally drop dead already, you creep!
Persona!!

entries.text_jp: かかってくれるとはねェ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Gah...!! How can this be?!

entries.text_jp: アンタ運はたった1杖の
entries.translation_en: My barrier... cracked?!

entries.text_jp: ｜鍖の破片』というエサにつられ
entries.translation_en: Impossible!! Absolutely impossible!!

entries.text_jp: このワタクシに勝つことの
entries.translation_en: I cannot lose to the likes of you!!

entries.text_jp: 申禾るチャンスを自分の手で
entries.translation_en: The power of Nemesis Tower is infinite!!
I will not fall!!
Nanjo: What did you say?!
Her aura is flaring up again!
She's drawing power from the tower itself!
Michiko: Ohohoho! Did you think it was over?!
As long as this tower stands, I am invincible!!
Your futile resistance only feeds my strength!!
Now, perish in agony!!
Ayase: Hey, ugly!
You're just putting on a big show!
You ugly hag! Just because we took the 'Mirror Shards'

entries.text_jp: アヤセ運に取られたから
entries.translation_en: from you,
you're in a total panic

entries.text_jp: ハッタリかましてるだけでしょ?
entries.translation_en: and bluffing through your teeth, aren't you?!
You lying little fake!!
Just give up already

entries.text_jp: アヤセ運にやられちゃえ!
entries.translation_en: and take your beating from Ayase and the gang!

entries.text_jp: この｜ネメシスの塔』はねェ
entries.translation_en: Michiko: This 'Nemesis Tower' of mine...
is a domain fueled by human despair and resentment!
Every selfish desire feeds into its core!

entries.text_jp: エネルギ{204}として嗅収しながら
entries.translation_en: Did you really think taking the Mirror Shards
would weaken my divine authority?!

entries.text_jp: いわば｜生きている塔』なのよ
entries.translation_en: Quite the contrary!
Your greed only amplified my power tenfold!!

entries.text_jp: エネルギ{204}をこのワタクシが
entries.translation_en: Look upon my true form and weep!

entries.text_jp: 体にとりいれることで
entries.translation_en: Megami Nemesis, awaken in full splendor!!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシは限りなく独くなる
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Watch out! Her power surged!
She's not playing around anymore!

entries.text_jp: なっていたんですのよ
entries.translation_en: Keep your focus, don't let her overwhelm us!
Mark: Damn, what's with this crazy heat?!

entries.text_jp: クククク…擇聞を受けている
entries.translation_en: She's going all out!

entries.text_jp: あの醵女二人の苦痛から
entries.translation_en: We gotta hit her with everything we've got!
Brown: W-Whoa, that looks seriously dangerous!
Don't choke now, team!

entries.text_jp: 肪けてくれると信じていた
entries.translation_en: Tir na nOg, blow this witch away!

entries.text_jp: 友人運に見捨てられたという
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Stay calm! Form up!
No matter how immense her demonic strength,
a monster driven by blind malice will always have a flaw!

entries.text_jp: どれも皆とてもスバらしい
entries.translation_en: Find the opening and strike decisively!

entries.text_jp: パワ{204}をこのワタクシの体に
entries.translation_en: Elly: Yes! Her magical core is fluctuating!
If we coordinate our Persona attacks,

entries.text_jp: うらむなら自分運のいやしい
entries.translation_en: we can shatter her demonic shield!

entries.text_jp: 忤根をうらみなさいな!
entries.translation_en: Let us combine our strengths!
Ayase: You're going down, snob queen!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜かにすごいパワ{204}だ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, her power is astonishing!

entries.text_jp: ヤツはただ立っている
entries.translation_en: However, we shall not falter!
Number One never surrenders!
Michiko: Insolent insects!!
Drown in eternal darkness!!
Judgment Flame!!
Perish, perish, PERISH!!
Yukino: Now! All together!!

entries.text_jp: ヤツはパワ{204}アップしたのか…
entries.translation_en: Persona, strike!!
A blinding flash erupts across the chamber!
The demon Nemesis roars in agony!
Michiko's barrier shatters into countless fragments!
Michiko: Aaaaaaaagh!!

entries.text_jp: 立っているだけなのに…!
entries.translation_en: My barrier... my power...!!

entries.text_jp: 擇聞を受けていた二人の
entries.translation_en: How could mere mortals breach my defenses?!
It cannot be...!!
To think Michiko's Power
became so ridiculously Big
and unmanageable...

entries.text_jp: 完全にウラをかかれましたわ!
entries.translation_en: We were completely outsmarted by her trap!
Michiko: Now then...
You who dared defy the 'Snow Queen'...

entries.text_jp: このワタクシをバカにした…
entries.translation_en: You who dared insult and ridicule ME...

entries.text_jp: 身の榲知らずの小尤ちゃん運の
entries.translation_en: It is time for you insolent little kittens
to pay the ultimate price!!

entries.text_jp: かつてワタクシを簑切った
entries.translation_en: Accept your execution!!

entries.text_jp: 人間どもの顔のなかに
entries.translation_en: Perish under the wrath of Nemesis!!
The final battle reaches its climax!
The party unleashes their ultimate Persona strikes!
Nemesis is overwhelmed by righteous power!

entries.text_jp: 人間の本龍をムキ申しにして!
entries.translation_en: A colossal shockwave shatters the demonic throne!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシに向かっておいで!!
entries.translation_en: Michiko's demonic transformation collapses!

entries.text_jp: それすらもワタクシに
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Gwaaaaahhh!!
N-Noooooo!!

entries.text_jp: ゴチソウなんだからねェ!
entries.translation_en: My beauty... my power... everything...!!
Aaaargh?! Why... why is this happening to me?!
Noooo!! Ohoho... aaaaaaahhh!!
Nanjo: What a painfully shrill woman.
Nanjo: Our victory was inevitable.

entries.text_jp: 今は目の前のコイツを
entries.translation_en: Twisting your unsightly face
into an even uglier sneer and wailing like that
will not alter this reality.

entries.text_jp: ずいぶんノンビリした
entries.translation_en: A loser should act like a loser
and accept defeat with whatever grace they have left.

entries.text_jp: 待ちくたびれてしまいましてよ!
entries.translation_en: Michiko: L-Loser...? You call ME a loser?!
How dare you... how dare you speak down to me!!

entries.text_jp: 塔の刷限時間を解瞭して
entries.translation_en: I am Lady Michiko Matsudaira!!
I was meant to rule above all of you!!

entries.text_jp: 勝つコトの申禾るチャンスを
entries.translation_en: Why... why does everyone always ruin my dreams?!
With your own hands,

entries.text_jp: 捨ててくれたのですものねェ!
entries.translation_en: you threw them all away!

entries.text_jp: 笶いが止まりませんわ
entries.translation_en: I can't stop laughing at your foolishness!
You ugly hag!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ運に莫けそうだから
entries.translation_en: Just because you're about to lose to Ayase and the gang,
that you didn't come to save,

entries.text_jp: 不安な思いから生まれた
entries.translation_en: born out of anxious, fearful thoughts,
we've got plenty of it, oh yes~!

entries.text_jp: アンタ運が時間をかけてここに禾てくれたおかげですわ
entries.translation_en: It's all thanks to you spending so much time getting here!
I truly thank you for that!
If only we had paid

entries.text_jp: もっと住意していれば…!
entries.translation_en: more attention to what wasn't there...!
Victory... is ours!
Do you still... wanna keep going?
To think I could lose...!
No! ...How could such a thing happen?!
And to you, of all people!!

entries.text_jp: おぉ!?どうしてなんですの?
entries.translation_en: Aargh?! Why... why is this happening to me?!
Aargh!! Oho... aaaaaagh!!
Nanjo: What an obnoxious woman.
The reason we won
is because our bonds and resolve were genuine.

entries.text_jp: さらに醵くして騒いだところで
entries.translation_en: Even if you wail and contort your face in fury,

entries.text_jp: この現実は変わらんのだ
entries.translation_en: this outcome will not change.
Accept your defeat like a proper loser.

entries.text_jp: さっさと俺運の目の前から
entries.translation_en: Michiko: No... I refuse to accept this!
I am a Matsudaira! The heir to a prestigious lineage!!
How could I be brought low by a band of common delinquents?!

entries.text_jp: もォうるせぇンだよォッ!
entries.translation_en: It makes no sense!!
Yukino: Your status doesn't mean squat in a real fight.
You relied on demon power because you couldn't face your own weakness.
Brown: Yeah! You were hiding behind a fancy mask the whole time!
Take away your demon magic, and you're just an insecure crybaby!
Michiko: Crybaby...?! ME?!

entries.text_jp: ｜おうおう』オットセイみたく
entries.translation_en: You insolent clown!!

entries.text_jp: いつまでも騒いでねぇで
entries.translation_en: I am the epitome of beauty and grace!!

entries.text_jp: おれ達の前から消えてくれ!
entries.translation_en: I was supposed to be the shining star of St. Hermelin!!

entries.text_jp: そのとぉりッていうかぁ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Everyone was supposed to bow before me!!
Why did it turn out like this...?!
Why did everyone abandon me?!

entries.text_jp: もう見たくないって感じ?
entries.translation_en: In elementary school, in middle school... I was always Number One!
I was praised by every teacher! Admired by every student!
And yet, the moment high school began...
Those vulgar girls started forming their own little cliques!
They ignored my invitations!
They laughed at my family's traditions!
They called me an outcast behind my back!!

entries.text_jp: 5人がかりでよってたかって
entries.translation_en: They treated me like I didn't even exist!!

entries.text_jp: 何もしていないワタクシを
entries.translation_en: Do you have any idea how humiliating that was?!

entries.text_jp: いぢめて勝ち誇るなんて!!
entries.translation_en: Do you have any idea how much it HURT?!
Every single day was a living nightmare!!

entries.text_jp: いつもそうなんですわ!!
entries.translation_en: I cried alone in the bathroom every afternoon!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシの部厘の呈に
entries.translation_en: And not a single soul came to ask if I was alright!!
Not one!!
Elly: Michiko... that must have been very painful.
Being isolated and rejected by peers is a heavy burden.
However, turning that sorrow into cruelty towards others
will never heal your heart.

entries.text_jp: アンタ運に理解できる?
entries.translation_en: It will only plunge you deeper into isolation.

entries.text_jp: ありあまるお舍にモノをいわせて｜雪の女王』の庄を
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Don't you dare pity me!!
I don't need your condescending sympathy!!

entries.text_jp: あこがれの演馴部の旡肇の模で
entries.translation_en: I wanted power! Power to make them all regret what they did!

entries.text_jp: 彼女ヅラしてるヤな女を
entries.translation_en: Power to make them kneel and beg for my forgiveness!!
And the Snow Queen gave me that power!!
She showed me that only strength matters in this world!!
Yukino: And look where that power got you.

entries.text_jp: 少引イロをつけてもらったり
entries.translation_en: Broken, defeated, and more alone than ever.

entries.text_jp: しただけなのよワタクシは!!
entries.translation_en: I was only trying to protect myself!!

entries.text_jp: なのにクラスの鳥庖どもは
entries.translation_en: And yet those flocking fools in class
constantly talked behind my back,
and ostracized me completely...

entries.text_jp: 手を草し押べてくれたのは
entries.translation_en: The only one who ever reached out a hand to me
was the 'Mask of the Snow Queen'...
and nothing else!
All of my sorrow!

entries.text_jp: 不宰をわかってくれたのは
entries.translation_en: All of my bitter tears!
I offered them all to Her Majesty the Snow Queen!

entries.text_jp: ねぇ?何の燿刮があって
entries.translation_en: She gave me a purpose!
She gave me a kingdom where I could rule supreme!!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシをいぢめるの??
entries.translation_en: And you... you destroyed it all!!

entries.text_jp: まったく理解できませんわ!
entries.translation_en: You took away my only sanctuary!!
Nanjo: That is... while your pain may be real,

entries.text_jp: 手達が悪いんだろうが!!
entries.translation_en: you cannot blame the entire world for your own missteps.

entries.text_jp: 手達…本当にそれが理由で
entries.translation_en: The Snow Queen did not offer you salvation;

entries.text_jp: 現実械晃での生活を捨て
entries.translation_en: she merely used your despair as fuel for her curse.
You were nothing more than a pawn to her.
Michiko: Silence! A pawn?!

entries.text_jp: この塔の守護者になったのか?
entries.translation_en: I am Lady Michiko Matsudaira!!

entries.text_jp: それは全面吋にあなたが
entries.translation_en: I am second to none!!
Even if this tower collapses,
the Queen's ice will freeze this entire school forever!!

entries.text_jp: そんな理由で現実での
entries.translation_en: You will never defeat her!!
Never!!
Ayase: Keep barking, loser!
We took down your tower, and we'll take down your Queen next!
You're yesterday's news!
Mark: Yeah! Hand over the Mirror Shard already!
We're done listening to your pity party!

entries.text_jp: 語れないこのワタクシの
entries.translation_en: Michiko: The Mirror Shard...?

entries.text_jp: 悲しい過去を聞いても
entries.translation_en: Ohohoho... you want this filthy shard so badly?!
Then take it!!
A gleaming shard of the Devil's Mirror drops to the floor!
Obtained the 'Mirror Shard'!

entries.text_jp: しょせんアンタ運のような
entries.translation_en: Michiko: But do not think this is over!!
Do not think for a single second that you have won!!

entries.text_jp: ハイソなワタクシの悲しみを
entries.translation_en: As long as hatred resides in human hearts,

entries.text_jp: 理解しろというほうが無理な
entries.translation_en: my vengeance will never die!!

entries.text_jp: 梠談だったようですわね!
entries.translation_en: I will return!!
I will rise from the icy abyss and drag you down with me!!

entries.text_jp: 今日だけはアンタ運の
entries.translation_en: Elly: Michiko is dissolving into shadows!
Yukino: She's making a run for it!

entries.text_jp: しておいてあげましてよ!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Good riddance to bad rubbish, I say!

entries.text_jp: ただ覚悟しておくことですわ…
entries.translation_en: Michiko: Remember my words, fools!!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシの沚に渦巻く
entries.translation_en: Whenever you look into a mirror,

entries.text_jp: アンタ運への復讐の衾が
entries.translation_en: you will see my wrath staring back at you!!

entries.text_jp: 冉び時をへて梼ちた時!
entries.translation_en: I shall bestow upon you
the curse of eternal torment!!
I shall bestow it upon you with pleasure!!

entries.text_jp: おぉ{204}ぼえてらっしゃい!!
entries.translation_en: Remember this well~!!

entries.text_jp: ワタクシは何痍でも何痍でも
entries.translation_en: I will appear before you again and again,

entries.text_jp: アンタ運の前に現れましてよ!
entries.translation_en: standing in your path no matter where you go!
Look forward to that moment

entries.text_jp: 杲しみにしておくことね!!
entries.translation_en: with dread and terror in your hearts!!
That's someone I hope

entries.text_jp: 会いたくない梠手だね
entries.translation_en: we never, ever have to cross paths with again.
Seriously, what a psycho.

entries.text_jp: トロと黒瓜…大夫夬かな?
entries.translation_en: I wonder if Toro and Kurosu... are doing alright?
Let's hurry back down and free them from those chains!
Yeah, let's get them out of there!
We got the key and the Mirror Shard!
Nemesis Tower is cleared!
Let's head toward the next tower!
Two towers remaining!
We can do this, team!

entries.text_jp: なんだいこのガイコツ部厘は?
entries.translation_en: The party descends the tower and frees the captives.
???: Yahoo~!
Well, look who finally showed up!
Did you miss me, everyone?
I've been waiting for you for so long~!
Yukino: Who's there?!
Show yourself!
Mark: What the... who's this girl?!
She popped out of nowhere!
Elly: Such a mysterious presence...
She does not seem to be a normal human.
Brown: Whoa, she's kinda cute, actually!
Nanjo: What manner of joke is this?
Identify yourself at once!

entries.text_jp: 余計なお械話かもしれんが
entries.translation_en: ???: Oh, you're so impatient, Nanjo-kun~!
Can't a cute girl just say hello to her classmates?

entries.text_jp: 茫しい巳本語を払ってくれ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Classmates? Like, I've never seen your face before in my life!
Who are you trying to fool, girl?!
???: Hehehe, my name is Yuriko!
Your friendly neighborhood guide through this wonderful maze!

entries.text_jp: ノっちまったじゃねぇか!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Yuriko...? Never heard of you.
Are you one of the Snow Queen's minions?!
Yuriko: Minion? How terribly rude!
I'm just a free spirit enjoying the show!
Though I do find you guys awfully entertaining~

entries.text_jp: あァ{204}!巨合子がカワイイから
entries.translation_en: Aww~ is it because Yuriko is so cute
that you're all staring at me like that?

entries.text_jp: あんまりカワイイのも
entries.translation_en: You're making me blush!
Mark: Cut the crap! We don't have time for your games!
Tell us what you want or get out of our way!

entries.text_jp: 何しに申てきたのだ手達!?
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: My, so aggressive!

entries.text_jp: 俺運は旡を念いでいるのだ!
entries.translation_en: I was actually going to be nice and give you a helpful hint,
but if you're going to be so mean...

entries.text_jp: 俺運はいっこうかまわんぞ!
entries.translation_en: We wouldn't mind taking you on in the slightest!

entries.text_jp: 何しに申てきたのですか?
entries.translation_en: What did you come here for,
exactly?

entries.text_jp: 一貰交える気なのですか?
entries.translation_en: Are you itching for a fight?
As far as we are concerned,

entries.text_jp: いっこうにかまいませんよ?
entries.translation_en: we have no problem dealing with you!
Yuriko: Geez~ why are you all

entries.text_jp: この部厘の奧の扉の闢け方
entries.translation_en: so uptight and defensive?

entries.text_jp: を教えてあげるだけだよ{204}!
entries.translation_en: I came to teach you
how to open the door at the back of this room!

entries.text_jp: 巨合子ちゃんの扉の闢け方
entries.translation_en: Yuriko's method for opening the door,
it's a very special secret~
Aren't you even a little bit curious?
Yukino: Why would an enemy offer to help us?

entries.text_jp: ロウソクが2本あるでしょ?
entries.translation_en: What's the catch, Yuriko?!
Yuriko: Catch? There's no catch!

entries.text_jp: 消せば扉は闢くんだぞ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Well, maybe just a tiny little game~
A game of wits and choices!
If you solve my little puzzle, the door opens wide!

entries.text_jp: どう考えてもワナ具いね
entries.translation_en: If you fail... well, let's just say things get spicy!
Nanjo: A puzzle, you say?

entries.text_jp: やりにくい梠手かもね
entries.translation_en: We do not have time for your childish distractions.
That Yuriko person...
She is clearly up to no good.

entries.text_jp: この塔の雰囲気ってさ
entries.translation_en: Her aura is dripping with malice.

entries.text_jp: うまく言えないけど…さ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Totally agree!
She's giving me mega bad vibes!
That woman named Yuriko!

entries.text_jp: バカそうに見えるけど
entries.translation_en: She thinks she's so clever!
Brown: But hey, if she knows how to open the door,
maybe we should hear her out?
Might save us a ton of trouble!
Elly: We must proceed with extreme caution.

entries.text_jp: 人のコト超ナメてるッて
entries.translation_en: Demons of her caliber often weave riddles that lead into deadly traps.

entries.text_jp: なァ{204}んかムカツクよね!!
entries.translation_en: We cannot afford to let our guard down.
Yuriko: Ohoho, having a little team meeting?

entries.text_jp: やかましいのは綾臘ひとりで
entries.translation_en: Take all the time you need, darlings!

entries.text_jp: たくさんだというのに…
entries.translation_en: The candles in this room are slowly burning down...
Tick-tock, tick-tock~!
Mark: Dammit, she's mocking us again!
What's with those candles anyway?!
Yukino: Look at the pedestals around the room.
Each candle is imbued with strange magical energy.

entries.text_jp: 黠楫かわいかったよな!!
entries.translation_en: Yuriko: Ding-dong! Good observation, Sukeban-chan!
The candles hold the key to the seal!

entries.text_jp: いう女の恐いところは何を
entries.translation_en: Extinguish the right flames, and the path opens.

entries.text_jp: 考えているのかわからない
entries.translation_en: Extinguish the wrong ones, and... boom!
Nanjo: A binary trial.
A classic psychological trap.

entries.text_jp: はめるコトを杲しんで
entries.translation_en: She wants us to second-guess every decision.

entries.text_jp: いるみたいなんですもの
entries.translation_en: It looks like she's really watching us,
and just as Yukino says,
an orthodox, straightforward approach will not work
against an opponent like this.

entries.text_jp: ロウソクの米を消しますか?
entries.translation_en: Will you extinguish the candle flame?
is it?
Waaaargh!!
Yuriko: Yay, yaaay~!

entries.text_jp: ひっかかった!ひっかかった!
entries.translation_en: Did that surprise you?

entries.text_jp: タダで僵れると思ったのォ?!
entries.translation_en: The flame flickered with dark energy!

entries.text_jp: 人生は｜ギブアンドテイク』よ
entries.translation_en: A trap mechanism triggered!

entries.text_jp: この塔で何かをしたかったら
entries.translation_en: Demons materialize from the shadows!

entries.text_jp: この巨合子ちゃんに何かを
entries.translation_en: Mark: Damn it! It was a trap after all!!

entries.text_jp: くれなくっちゃ!ダメダメよ!
entries.translation_en: I knew we shouldn't have trusted her!

entries.text_jp: 人生はキビシイのよん!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Get ready to fight!!
Take out the demons first!

entries.text_jp: もう一人のあなたの命
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Maintain formation!
Do not let the enemy disrupt our lines!
Ayase: Ugh, this is so annoying!!
Persona, blast them away!
The party swiftly defeats the summoned demons.
The chamber falls quiet once more.
Yuriko: Aww, you beat them already?
You really are tough cookies!
I like strong people~
Elly: Yuriko, stop playing these games.
What is the true condition to unseal the door?
Yuriko: Fine, fine, since you asked so nicely~
Look closely at the candle on the north altar.

entries.text_jp: どちらかのロウソクの
entries.translation_en: Its flame burns with pure cerulean light.
That is the flame of truth.
Brown: The blue flame, huh?
Are you sure she's not tricking us again?
Nanjo: Examine the runic inscriptions beneath the altar.
They correspond to the ancient sealing script of the tower.
She appears to be telling the truth this time.

entries.text_jp: 部厘の奧に宝箱が二つだけ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Alright, let's douse the blue candle.

entries.text_jp: きっとロウソクの部厘と
entries.translation_en: Carefully approach the altar.
The cerulean flame extinguishes with a soft hiss.

entries.text_jp: さわらぬ神にナンとやらだ
entries.translation_en: A heavy rumbling echoes through the chamber.

entries.text_jp: さわらないようにしよう
entries.translation_en: The sealed stone door slowly slides open!

entries.text_jp: ガンバるみんなのために
entries.translation_en: Mark: It actually worked!

entries.text_jp: 注意したプレゼントなのにぃ
entries.translation_en: The path is clear!

entries.text_jp: ムシして行っちゃうなんて
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Woohoo! Finally!

entries.text_jp: どうせワナなのだろう
entries.translation_en: See ya never, Yuriko!
Yuriko: Wait, wait, don't leave just yet~!
The fun part is just beginning!

entries.text_jp: もらっときましょうよ!
entries.translation_en: Beyond this door lies the true trial of the tower.

entries.text_jp: 葺ッから言うじゃないスか
entries.translation_en: I have a special gift for you before you proceed!
Nanjo: A gift from a demon? We have no interest in your tainted trinkets.

entries.text_jp: 巨合子ちゃんを信じましょう!
entries.translation_en: Let's trust in Yuriko-chan!
It smells totally like a trap, but
it sounds pretty interesting, doesn't it?
Somehow,

entries.text_jp: 話だけでも聞いてあげる!
entries.translation_en: I'll at least listen to what you have to say!
Yuriko: Yappii~!
You've got the face of someone

entries.text_jp: 齟だけあってわかってるぅ!
entries.translation_en: I can really get along with, you totally get it!
I knew you were smart, darling!
Here's the deal:
Before you face the guardian of the inner sanctum,

entries.text_jp: 手達の日諢は不偸快だ
entries.translation_en: I will offer you two distinct items.
You can only choose ONE of them!
Choose wisely, because your decision cannot be undone!

entries.text_jp: 話を聞くだけムダですわ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What kind of items are we talking about?
Yuriko: Hehehe, glad you asked!

entries.text_jp: 素直じゃない人ばっかり!
entries.translation_en: The first item is bathed in crimson light.
The second item glows with a pale azure radiance.
Each one has a very specific purpose.

entries.text_jp: この二つの宝箱のうちの
entries.translation_en: Mark: What do they actually DO?
No riddles, just tell us straight!
Yuriko: Fine, fine, impatient boy!
Listen closely now:
Item Number One is an offensive artifact.

entries.text_jp: それを巨合子ちゃんは
entries.translation_en: It holds the power of absolute annihilation.
Item Number Two is a defensive charm.

entries.text_jp: チャンスをあたえちゃいます!
entries.translation_en: It grants protection against mortal curses.
Elly: An offensive weapon versus a protective talisman...
Depending on the boss's attack patterns,

entries.text_jp: と{204}ぜん間違った宝箱を
entries.translation_en: the correct choice could turn the tide of battle.

entries.text_jp: 闢けちゃうとペナルティありよ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Or one of them could be a cursed dud.
We must weigh the risks carefully.
Ayase: Ugh, decisions, decisions!
I say we go for the weapon and blast everything to bits!
Brown: Nah, defense is key! A dead hero does zero damage!

entries.text_jp: やってみようよミンナ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What do you think, leader?
It's your call.
Yuriko: Ohoho, discussing your strategy?

entries.text_jp: アヤセがセキニン持つから!
entries.translation_en: I love seeing the look of contemplation on your cute faces!
Take all the time you need, but remember:
Once you pick an item, the other vanishes forever!

entries.text_jp: 掌の部でもてあそんで
entries.translation_en: And whatever consequences follow,
you must bear them on your own shoulders!
Are you ready to make your choice?
The crimson artifact pulses with lethal energy.

entries.text_jp: すごく無理してるって感じ?
entries.translation_en: The azure talisman radiates a calm, protective barrier.
Examine the two relics carefully.
Which one will you select?
Yuriko watches with an enigmatic smile.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ワナには2僮類ある
entries.translation_en: Her eyes gleam with playful anticipation.
One of them

entries.text_jp: 梠手を曜実に殺すためのモノ
entries.translation_en: is an artifact meant to surely slaughter your foe,
while the other is
